## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Harness captures pre-migration token counts for 5 sites on pre HEAD (SHA recorded)
- dd-2: Harness captures post-migration counts for same 5 sites on post HEAD (SHA recorded) and computes per-site/aggregate %

## Description
Implement per-site capture: for each of 5 sites (impl-plan :511, :978, :1238; preplanning :513; sprint :2332), the harness checks out pre_head_sha, extracts return block at that line, then post_head_sha, repeats. Snapshot mode `--use-snapshots <dir>` reads pre-captured text from disk (for tests). Records pre+post counts + both SHAs per site.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] All 5 sites captured pre and post
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Per-site record carries both HEAD SHAs verbatim
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Missing snapshot causes non-zero exit
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
